target.title: fix(tlon): cancel unread channel-ops and SSE connect bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Tlon Urbit HTTP helpers in `channel-ops.ts` (create/wake/poke/scry) and the SSE
`openStream` failure path call `release()` without cancelling unread response
bodies. `release()` from `fetchWithSsrFGuard` does not cancel streams, so undici
can keep sockets pinned on status-only success (create/wake/poke 200) and on
`!ok` throws (scry / SSE connect).

**Out of scope / not this PR:** #111229 cancels poke bodies in
`extensions/tlon/src/channel.runtime.ts` (`createHttpPokeApi().poke`). This PR
only touches `urbit/channel-ops.ts` and `urbit/sse-client.ts`.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Add `releaseUrbitGuardedResponse` in `channel-ops.ts` that cancels when
  `!bodyUsed` before `release()`, and use it from poke/scry/create/wake.
- On SSE `openStream` non-OK, cancel unread body before `release()` (same file
  already cancels on unsubscribe/close).

## User Impact

**Before:** Channel open / scry failures / failed SSE connects against a
streaming or held body could leave request sockets open after the error/success
returned.

**After:** Those paths cancel unread bodies promptly. Successful scry still
consumes JSON via `readProviderJsonResponse` (`bodyUsed` → cancel no-op).
Successful SSE streams still hand the body to `processStream`.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.ts`,
  `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/sse-client.ts`,
  `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.transport.test.ts`,
  `extensions/tlon/src/urbit/sse-client.connect-fail.transport.test.ts`
- Does **not** change `channel.runtime.ts` (#111229)

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

Unread bodies on channel-ops status-only / scry `!ok` and SSE connect `!ok` must
be cancelled so undici releases the socket.

### Canonical reachability path

- `ensureUrbitChannelOpen` → create/wake PUT → cancel unread → `release()`
- `scryUrbitPath` → `!ok` throw → cancel unread → `release()`
- `UrbitSSEClient.openStream` → `!response.ok` → cancel → `release()` →
  `UrbitHttpError`

### Shared helper / provider constraint check

Uses existing `urbitFetch` / `fetchWithSsrFGuard`. Sibling cancel already exists
in the same SSE client for unsubscribe/close. Distinct from #111229's
`channel.runtime` poke helper.

### Real environment tested

**Production `scryUrbitPath` before/after** (loopback 503 + open body):

Negative control (cancel removed from helper):

```text
{"productionFunction":"scryUrbitPath","threw":"Scry for path /chat/inbox.json failed: 503","returnedAtMs":143,"serverObservedSocketClose":false,"socketCloseAfterStartMs":null}
```

After fix:

```text
{"productionFunction":"scryUrbitPath","threw":"Scry for path /chat/inbox.json failed: 503","returnedAtMs":43,"serverObservedSocketClose":true,"socketCloseAfterStartMs":43}
```

macOS, Node v22.23.1. Throw text unchanged; only socket release changes.

### Evidence after fix

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.transport.test.ts \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/sse-client.connect-fail.transport.test.ts \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose

 ✓ cancels unread create/wake bodies and closes the request socket
 ✓ cancels unread scry failure bodies and closes the request socket
 ✓ cancels unread non-OK stream bodies and closes the request socket
 ✓ rejects malformed scry response JSON

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

```text
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.ts \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/sse-client.ts \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/channel-ops.transport.test.ts \
  extensions/tlon/src/urbit/sse-client.connect-fail.transport.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

Premise: Undici requires every response body to be consumed or canceled.

AI-assisted: Yes.
